name: concurrent_fetch
prompt:
Explain what this Renyi program does in at most three sentences, for a reader who will decide whether to use it. Do not quote code.

module concurrent_fetch
  purpose: Download several pages at once and report their sizes.

import std.console
import std.http exposing Url, HttpError
import std.time

public type PageSize
  purpose: How many characters one page has.
  has url: Url
  has characters: Integer
end

public function measure(url: Url) returns PageSize or fails with HttpError needs network.http
  purpose: Download one page and measure its body.

  let response be http.get(url) otherwise fail
  return PageSize(url: url, characters: response.body.length())
end

public function main() or fails with HttpError or TimedOut needs console, network.http
  purpose: Measure three sites in parallel and print the largest first.

  let urls be [Url("https://example.com"), Url("https://example.org"), Url("https://example.net")]
  let sizes be for each url in urls concurrently collect measure(url) otherwise fail
  for each size in sizes sorted by size.characters descending
    console.print("{size.url}: {size.characters} characters")
  end

  run concurrently within time.seconds(10)
    let home be measure(Url("https://example.com")) otherwise fail
    let docs be measure(Url("https://example.com/docs")) otherwise fail
  end
  console.print("home and docs together: {home.characters + docs.characters} characters")
end

test "the example site is measured" needs network.http replays "fixtures/concurrent_fetch.json"
  let size be measure(Url("https://example.com")) otherwise fail
  check size.characters is 577
end
